method: Cross-source match set supplied as FINAL_matches.csv (per-triple candidate matches across Al-Makhazen / Promarche / Spinneys, each pre-scored by a combination of unit-price cross-checking ('high'/'medium'/'low' tiers), LLM review ('llm'), and name-similarity scoring ('score')). This build applied three additional, automated safeguards before accepting a row into the map: (1) dropped every row already labelled 'low' confidence; (2) dropped rows where the matched product names share not one meaningful word in common, since a price/score coincidence alone isn't evidence of the same identity; (3) resolved cases where the same single-retailer listing had been matched to more than one different product on another side (a logical contradiction) by keeping only the strongest-agreement match and dropping the rest, rather than guessing. See scripts/build_product_map.md for the full breakdown.
